title: A perfect weak generator classically generates perfect algebraic-space complexes
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]: every open cover of $|X|$ has a finite subcover, and the absolute diagonal is quasi-compact. Use its small etale structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$, module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C_X=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the full subcategory with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Perfect means etale locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Let $G\in C_X$ be perfect and suppose that, for every $F\in C_X$, vanishing of $\operatorname{Hom}(G[n],F)$ for all integers $n$ implies $F\simeq0$. Every perfect $P\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ belongs to the thick closure $\langle G\rangle$ [def-pc-thick-closure], the smallest full subcategory of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ containing $G$ and closed under isomorphisms, integer shifts, distinguished cones and retracts.

proof.text: Put $D=D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $A=C_X$. The ambient category is triangulated by [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. By [lem-sfb-space-perfect-localizing-generation], $A$ is strictly full and closed under shifts, cones, retracts and set-indexed ambient coproducts. In particular it contains zero (the empty coproduct), and is a full triangulated subcategory with the induced triangles. Choose its coproducts to be the ambient ones: fullness restricts their universal property to $A$. Thus both the countable coproducts and the attaching coproducts below are the same in $A$ and $D$.

Fix a perfect $P$. By [lem-sfb-space-perfect-objects-compact], both $G$ and $P$ belong to $A$ and are compact there. This uses exactly the quasi-compact and quasi-separated hypotheses on $X$; no ambient compactness is asserted.

The shift autoequivalence [def-weil-triangulated-category] gives $\operatorname{Hom}(G,F[n])\cong\operatorname{Hom}(G[-n],F)$. Hence the hypothesis says that $G$ is a weak generator as in [def-pc-generators]: a nonzero $F$ cannot have all these groups zero. Apply [lem-pc-compact-generators-build-objects] in $A$ to the singleton family $E_1=G$ and $Y=P$. It supplies a tower $Y_1\to Y_2\to\cdots$, with $Y_1$ and every attaching $Z_n$ coproducts of shifts of $G$, triangles $Z_n\to Y_n\to Y_{n+1}\to Z_n[1]$, and the telescope triangle $S\xrightarrow{1-s}S\to P\to S[1]$, where $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge1}Y_n$ and $s\iota_n=\iota_{n+1}t_n$. All index sets are taken in the fixed universe.

Normalize the tower by setting $X_0=0$ and $X_n=Y_n$ for $n\ge1$. Its first triangle is $0\to Y_1\xrightarrow{1}Y_1\to0$; for $n\ge1$ rotate the preceding triangles to $Y_n\to Y_{n+1}\to Z_n[1]\to Y_n[1]$, using [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Each $Z_n[1]$ is again a coproduct of shifts of $G$: maps from it to $T$ are maps from $Z_n$ to $T[-1]$, hence families of maps from its summands to $T[-1]$, equivalently from their shifts to $T$. Adding the zero summand gives $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}X_n\cong S$, by the identity on every $Y_n$ and the unique maps on zero. This isomorphism identifies the shift operators (the initial transition has zero source), so it carries the telescope triangle to the required triangle for the normalized tower.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-compact-generator-ambient-thick] with ambient category $D$, full subcategory $A$, compact objects $G,P$, and the normalized telescope. Step 1 supplies the ambient coproduct closure, step 2 the internal compactness, and steps 3–4 all the prescribed triangles and coproduct cofans. Its conclusion is precisely $P\in\langle G\rangle$ in the ambient category $D$, as required.
